results.title: IT Security Policy
results.heading: Lost or stolen devices
results.text: A lost or stolen device must be reported to the IT service desk within 24 hours.

results.title: IT Security Policy
results.heading: USB storage
results.text: USB storage devices are blocked on company laptops.

results.title: Code of Conduct
results.heading: Speak-up line
results.text: Concerns can be reported anonymously through the speak-up line. Retaliation against anyone who reports a concern in good faith is prohibited.

results.title: IT Security Policy
results.heading: Phishing
results.text: Suspected phishing emails must be reported with the Report Phish button in the mail app.

results.title: Code of Conduct
results.heading: Accepting gifts
results.text: Employees may accept gifts from suppliers or clients worth up to $100 per year from any one source. Gifts above that value must be declined or reported to Compliance.
